continuity.tod: late morning at the harbour (continuous from 1B)
continuity.weather: clear; the last mist over the water and against the seaward side of the outer rocks; light breeze off the sea
continuity.notes: CONTINUOUS from 1B-15: Leaf launches first (Abby), then Charcoal (Remi) tears the cleared launch space (the launch scar mended in X19). Same sun as 1B (east, ~31 deg up). The flight line (1C-10/11) runs along the coast with Leaf behind and on the near (inland) side; screen direction L -> R held through 1E.

shots.staging: MEDIUM 50 mm STATIC from the quay, looking north along it (the Santa Maria soft beyond, right): a working dragon about Leaf's size (slate grey) crouches low and level, wrists of the folded wings on the stones, head toward the catch; the crew sort fish into baskets at left, full baskets right; it waits for its share.

shots.staging: WIDE 35 mm STATIC from the slipway (the quay's south end, looking south-east down the slip, the sun high left): two boats bring in a heavy net between them out on the basin (background); a second, smaller working dragon (slate grey) walks the slack line up the slipway (centre, toward screen right), low on its two legs and the wrists of its folded wings, the line running from its jaws back to the net; the crew (right) haul a second line from the near boat in time.
